note: Provider-neutral vocabulary for the engineering work a skill needs done. Data, not logic: scripts/tools.py reads it and needs no per-capability branching. Every capability maps to exactly one action class. This contract is a candidate for freezing at 1.0 — see docs/engineering-tool-capabilities.md. Adding a capability is additive; renaming or reclassifying one is a breaking change.

action_classes.READ: Observes state. No mutation. Safe to run without confirmation; still subject to bounded-output rules for anything large.
action_classes.WRITE: Mutates state in a recoverable, normally-scoped way — a comment, an issue, a branch, a single row with a predicate, a local install.
action_classes.ELEVATED: Mutates shared or production-shaped state where a human answer is the right control — an infra apply, a deploy, a package publish, a pipeline trigger.
action_classes.DESTRUCTIVE: Removes or overwrites state that is hard or impossible to recover — a destroy, a drop, a truncate, a force-delete. Governed by the Execution Guard hard-deny floor.

scm.repository.read.summary: Read repository metadata, branches, files, commits.

scm.pull_request.read.summary: Read pull/merge request state, diffs, reviews, checks.

scm.pull_request.write.summary: Open, comment on, or update a pull/merge request.

scm.issue.write.summary: Open, comment on, or transition an issue.

scm.branch.write.summary: Create or update a branch or ref.

tracker.issue.read.summary: Read a tracker ticket: summary, description, status, links.

tracker.issue.write.summary: Create, comment on, or transition a tracker ticket.

tracker.project.read.summary: Read project, board, backlog, and sprint context.

knowledge.document.read.summary: Read a knowledge document or page.

knowledge.document.write.summary: Create or update a knowledge document.

communication.message.write.summary: Post a message. Not enabled for any reference tool in this release.

runtime.exec.summary: Execute a command inside a running workload.

runtime.container.write.summary: Start, stop, or update a container.

runtime.deploy.summary: Apply a workload change / roll out a deployment.

runtime.workload.delete.summary: Delete a workload, namespace, or node.

infrastructure.plan.summary: Produce a plan / preview of an infrastructure change. Does not mutate.

infrastructure.destroy.summary: Destroy infrastructure or remove resources from state.

cloud.resource.write.summary: Create or update a cloud resource.

cloud.resource.delete.summary: Delete or terminate a cloud resource.

api.collection.read.summary: Read an API collection and its requests.

api.request.read.summary: Read a single API request definition.

api.test.run.summary: Run an API collection / contract test. Side effects depend on the target.

ci.run.read.summary: Read CI run status and history.

ci.logs.read.summary: Read CI job logs. Bounded output.

ci.artifact.read.summary: Read CI build artifacts and reports.

quality.gate.read.summary: Read quality-gate status for a project or branch.

observability.errors.read.summary: Read error / exception groups and their releases.

incident.timeline.read.summary: Read an incident timeline / log of events.

incident.write.summary: Acknowledge, note, or update an incident.

messaging.message.sample.summary: Read a bounded sample of messages. Bounded output; never a full drain.

database.schema.read.summary: Read schema: tables, columns, indexes, constraints.

database.metadata.read.summary: Read catalog metadata, sizes, row estimates, activity.

database.query.read.summary: Run a bounded read-only query (SELECT). Row-limited.

database.explain.summary: Run EXPLAIN on a statement. Planning only: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the statement, including a DML one, so it is not covered here and needs database.write.

database.write.summary: Run a mutating statement with a predicate. DROP / TRUNCATE / unqualified DELETE remain on the Guard hard-deny floor.

data_pipeline.run.read.summary: Read pipeline / DAG / sync run status.

data_pipeline.logs.read.summary: Read pipeline run logs. Bounded output.

data_pipeline.model.read.summary: Read model / transformation definitions and lineage.

data_pipeline.trigger.summary: Trigger a pipeline / sync / DAG run.

package.install.summary: Install dependencies into the local project.

package.publish.summary: Publish a package to a registry.

design.read.summary: Read a design file / frame as engineering evidence.

design.component.read.summary: Read component / token specs from a design source.

security.secret.read.summary: Resolve a secret reference through a broker. The value never enters agent context — see the Access Resolver.

security.policy.read.summary: Read access policies and their bindings.
